senses.gloss: --a Mt. on the base of Meru. भा. V. १६. २६.
--a commander of भण्ड expert in माया and skilled in चित्रयुद्ध or कूटयुद्ध; an elder brother of Durmada; killed by देवी. Br. IV. २१. ७७; २२. ७१-108.
--a Mt. on the base of Meru. भा. V. १६. २६.
--Mt. on hill range on the east of Meru. Vi. II. 2. २७.
(I)--one of the fourteen गणस् of Apsaras, born of Soma's rays. Br. III. 7. १९; वा. ६९. ५५. [page१-405+ ३७]

(II) (c)--the land of Kurus, part of हरिताश्व kingdom; also कुरुवम्श।
1: M. १२. १८; ३५. 8; ६९. ११; १२१. ४९.
Situated between oceans and served by सिद्धस्; there is a मधुफल tree from which clothes and ornaments are taken; besides there is another tree क्षीरिण of six rasas, all the earth set with presious gems; people are born मिथुनस् and soon grow into lofty youthful men and women, loyal like चक्रवाक birds; they live १३,150 years. There are two kulaparvatas and a river भद्रशीम besides others flowing with honey, milk and ghee; there are gardens in it of तमाल, अगरु, sandal, etc., besides sporting grounds and creeper houses of different kinds and musical instruments of differ- ent varieties; men adorn themselves with beautiful jewels of all sorts. They are not troubled by disease or old age.
2: वा. ४५. ११-50.
(I)--a caste equal to क्षत्रिय in प्लक्षद्वीपा. Vi. II. 4. १७.
(II)--Thirty-six kings who were con- temporaries of ten शिसुनागस्. Br. III. ७४. १३७; M. २७२. १६; २७३. ७२.

(I)--a son of आग्नीध्र and पूर्वचित्ति;
1: भा. V. 2. १९; वा. ३३. ४०; Vi. II. 1. १७ and २२.
Lord of शृन्गवटम्.
2: Br. II. १४. ४७.
Kingdom north-east of शृङ्गवत्वर्ष.
3: वा. ३३. ४४; Br. II. १४. ५१.

(II)--a son of Samvarna and तपटी; occupied प्रयाग and established कुरुक्षेत्र; Lord of कुरुक्षेत्र. Had four (several-वि। प्।) sons--परीक्षित् and others.
1: भा. IX. २२. 4; वा. ९९. २१४-7;; Vi. १९. ७६-8.
परीक्- षित्'s son Janamejaya was his grandson? At कुरुक्षेत्र he performed तपस् and
2: Br. III. ६८. २१.
pleased Indra. Family members were known as Kauravas.
3: M. ५०. २०-2.
[page१-406+ ५०]
(III)--a son of Manu and नड्वला; wife आग्नेयी; gave birth to six sons, अङ्ग and others. Vi. I. १३. 5, 6.
(IV)--(Uttara) country of the; famous for a forest शड्वल. वा. ८४. २३, ४८.
(V)--a continent bounded by शृन्गवन् on one side. Here Hari is worshipped in his Boar incarnation by पृथ्वि (Earth) with the Kurus. भा. V. १६. 8; १८. ३४-9.

(VI)--an eastern kingdom watered by the Ganges. Its king was enlisted by जरासन्ध, against Yadus, but was vanquished by कृष्ण.
1: भा. I. १०. ३४. X. [५० (V) 2]; II. 7. ३५. Br. II. १८. ५०; III. ५९. 3 and ४६.
He took part in the festivities con- nected with the marriage of रुक्मिनी and कृष्ण.
2: भा. X. ५४. ५८.
He praised कृष्ण's heroism and welcomed him.
3: Ib. X. ७१. २९; ७२. 5; IX. २४. ६३.
Took part in the राजसूय of युधिष्ठिर.
4: Ib. X. ७५. १२.
He went to स्यमन्तपञ्चक for solar eclipse;
5: Ib. X. ८२. १३; ८४. ५५.
migration of Yadus to.
6: Ib. X. 2.

--founded by Kuru and sacred to हरी.
1: भा III. 3. १२; VII. १४. ३०; Vi. VI. 8. २९.
Watered by the river सरस्वती.
2: भा. IX. १४. ३३.
Capital city of the Kurus.
3: Ib. IX. २२. 4.
Sages of कुरुक्षेत्र visited द्वारक. At कुरुक्षेत्र Kr2s2n2a performed sacrifices for twelve years.
4: Ib. X. ९०. २८[3], ४६[1].
The battlefield where the पाण्डवस् fought with the Kurus led by Duryo- dhana.
5: Ib. X. ७८. [९५ (V) 9], [१८].
Here परशुराम dug a lake called स्यमन्तपञ्- caka.
6: Br. III. ४७. 2.
On the occasion of a sacrifice सूत narrated the ब्र्। पुराण here.
7: भा. I. 1. १७.
पुरूरवस् met उर्वशी after their separa- tion at; the residence of सनत्कुमार and धर्मराज fit for श्राद्ध offerings, and sacred to पितृस्. Founded by Kuru, son of सम्वरण;
8: III. १३. ६५ and ६८; ६६. १८; M. २२. १८; वा. ७७. ६४; ९१. ३१; ९९. २१५, २५९.
residence of sage कौशिक, and sacrifice of अधिसीमकृष्ण for 2 years at; sacred in द्वा- para;
9: M. २०. 2; ५०. २० and ६७; १०६. ४९ and ५७; १०९. 3; १८०. ५५; १८४. १६.
धर्मक्षेत्र where a great sacrifice was per- [page१-407+ ३०] formed.
१०: वा. 1. १४; ५९. १०७.
Residence at, leads to मुक्ति; no shaving or उप- वास required here.
११: Ib. १०५. १६ and २५.
Noted for अम्भोजसरस् or lotus tank.
१२: Vi. IV-१९. ७७.
R. सरस्वती flows here: noted for a temple of वामन.
१३: M. १८६. १०; १९२. १२; २४४. 3.

--the kingdom of परीक्षित्. Visited by शुक and Vidura;
1: भा. I. ४६; १०. ३४; १६. ११; III. 1. २४; Br. III. १३. १००; वा. ७७. ९३.
a पाञ्चाल kingdom.
2: M. २१. 9 and २८.
--heard of कृष्ण going to मिथिला and met him with presents. भा. X. ८६. २०.
--the son of अञ्जन and father of अरिष्टनेमि. Vi. IV. 5. ३१.

--a kingdom of मध्यदेश;
1: Br. II. १६. ४०; Vi. II. 3. १५.
a tribe; a Janapada.
2: M. ११४. ३४; वा. ४५. १०९.
--the son of Madhu and father of Anu. भा. IX. २४. 5.
--kings of रसातल, vanquished by कृष्ण. Br. III. ७३. १०३. [page१-408+ २६]
--the son of मीढ्वान् and father of Indrasena. भा. IX. 2. १९.
--a वर्ण S4akti. Br. IV. ४४. ६०.

--an अवतार् of Hari in the पातालम्.
1: भा. II. 7. १३; M. २४९. १६, २०; Vi. I. 4. 8.
In this form He is worshipped in हिरण्मय. By His help the churning of the ocean was possible. Also कूर्म-कच्छप।
2: भा. V. १८. २९; XI. 4. १८: X. 2. ४०.
Icon of.
3: M. २५९. 2; २६०. ३९; २८५. 6.
[page१-422+ ३०]
--the age when वामन पुराण was com- posed. M. ५३. ४६.
--the flesh of tortoise for a श्राद्ध। M. १७. ३३; ५८. १९.

--a महा pura1n2a of १८००० s4lokas (१७००० s4lokas, भा., वा। प्।);
1: भा. XII. 7. २४; १३. 8; Vi. III. 6. २३.
said in the presence of Indra containing anecdotes of Indradyumna and of लक्ष्मीकल्प. Gift of, with a golden tortoise on the अयनस् equals a gift of १००० cows.
2: M. ५३. ४७, ४९; वा. १०४. 9.
--the stone forming the lowest part of the base of an image. M. २६६. 5.
